message:
release(0.2.120): something for the fixed updater to reach

The 17:26 attempt failed again, and it says nothing about C1 or C2. The updater that
ran was the one already installed -- 0.2.116's -- while the fixes live in 0.2.119's.
The corrected code had never executed. Getting it installed required an update to
succeed, and the old updater was what kept failing them, so the loop closed on itself
and "just press the button" was wrong advice.

A stream child from the 16:49 attempt was still holding UDP 43000 thirty-eight minutes
later, orphaned by a parent that had gone.

Installing 0.2.119 by hand broke the loop: the installed updater is now 9f337637, the
registered version is 0.2.119, no GNLink process is running and both ports are free.
For the first time the updater carrying the fixes is the one that will do the work,
which left nothing newer to update to -- hence this release.

Version constant only; four binaries move because the version is stamped in them and
ui/shell.html is byte-identical. No dist copy this time: 0.2.120 is the target of the
test and installing it by hand would remove the thing being tested.
